summary: String-table lookup and copy helper carrying the legacy ABI name Season_Name_Lookup. Caches the table pointer off_5CCBD0[0], binary-searches it via BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, off_5CCBD0[0], byte_5EC4CC), and on a match copies the matched string into the global message buffer byte_5EC4CC (null-terminating it when the source pointer is null). Always copies up to a2-1 bytes from byte_5EC4CC into the caller-supplied output buffer a1 via sub_587DD0, null-terminates at a2-1+a1, and returns 0. Called by UIDebugOverlayRender (004dc0b0).

operations.description: Cache the table entry pointer: v2 = off_5CCBD0[0].
BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, off_5CCBD0[0], byte_5EC4CC): search the table for a key string; non-zero return indicates a match.
Only update the message buffer when the table search reports a match.
On match with non-null v2, copy the matched string into the global message buffer: strcpy(byte_5EC4CC, v2).
On match with null v2, clear the message buffer: byte_5EC4CC[0] = 0.
sub_587DD0(a1, byte_5EC4CC, a2 - 1): copy or concatenate the message buffer into the caller output buffer a1 up to a2-1 bytes.
Null-terminate the output buffer at a2-1+a1.
Return 0 unconditionally after filling the output buffer.

unresolved: Legacy ABI name Season_Name_Lookup implies the table pointer off_5CCBD0 holds season names, but that identification is not independently confirmed; the semantic identity of the table content is UNKNOWN.
sub_587DD0 semantics (copy vs concatenate, length handling) are in the callee and not confirmed here.
